title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry — Registry Status Goodwill on Price Protection (Merchandise Purchases)
content:
On registry price protection for a Merchandise Purchases unit, goodwill is paid according to the status of the registry recording the guest gift of the identical item, as shown in the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry records:

| Registry recording the guest gift | Registry status goodwill |
|---|---|
| in its completion period | completion registry status goodwill, $15.00 |
| still active, before its completion period | pre-event registry status goodwill, $5.00 |

A registrant whose registry is in neither status is outside this goodwill. Where the identical item has been bought as a guest gift more than once, the registry recording the latest such gift is the one read.

*Hypothetical:* a registry whose records show it still active, before its completion period, gives $5.00; the same registry, once its records show it in its completion period, gives $15.00.
